schema.bonus_ratio_rmb: Cash dividend per 10 shares before tax.
schema.dividend_ratio: Bonus shares per 10 shares when JoinQuant reports stock dividend shares.
schema.stock_dividend_ratio: (dividend_ratio + transfer_ratio) / 10. Used to adjust local unadjusted-price holdings.
schema.pay_date: Uses a_xr_date because STK_XR_XD does not expose a separate cash arrival date in the validated field set.

credential_policy: Credentials loaded from JQDATA_USERNAME/JQDATA_PASSWORD; credentials are never written.
